Hi Marissa — thanks for the quick follow-up. Answers inline below:

1) SCIM groups: We only want to provision a subset — groups with prefix MIRANA_. For example MIRANA_ENG, MIRANA_CLINICAL. We don’t want a full-directory push.

2) SAML assertions: Signing is required; encrypted assertions are optional but preferred. ACS exact-match only — we cannot accept wildcards for our SP.

3) RBAC: We need two custom roles in addition to Admin/Operator/Read-only: Billing-only (invoice view & api access for billing-related endpoints) and Compliance-Reviewer (access to audit logs & export, no data-plane read access).

Also, we require auth/audit logs exported to our SIEM (Splunk HTTP Event Collector) with a retention of 2 years for auth events and 6 years for exportable audit records related to PHI access.

Please let me know if any of that triggers additional questions.

Jenna

Hi Jenna, Amit — attached is our formal response PDF (Redwood_Mirana_IAM_Response_20270517.pdf). Below is a short executive summary of the answers, and the PDF includes field-level checkbox exports that map directly to your Excel.

Executive summary (high-level answers):
- SSO: Redwood supports both SAML 2.0 and OIDC (Auth code + PKCE). We support IdP-initiated and SP-initiated SAML flows.
- Assertions: Signing of assertions is required; encrypted assertions are supported (optional). ACS URL matching is configurable; for Mirana we will enforce exact-match only per your requirement.
- SCIM: We support SCIM 2.0 for users and groups. Scoped group synchronization is supported via attribute-based filtering (we can scope by prefix such as MIRANA_). We treat the IdP as authoritative for attributes marked as "primary" in the provisioning mapping. Conflicts are resolved using attribute-level last-write-wins unless policy overrides are specified; we can implement Mirana-specific transform rules in our provisioning layer.
- RBAC/Admin: Redwood provides built-in roles (Account Admin, Operator, Read-only). We support custom roles and can create Billing-only and Compliance-Reviewer roles. Role assignments can be managed via SCIM group mappings or via the Console.
- Audit & Exports: Auth and admin audit logs are retained for 2 years by default in our analytics store; export hooks to SIEMs (Splunk HEC, S3 sinks, syslog) are available. For export/retention beyond default windows (e.g., 6 years), we offer configurable archival + eDiscovery exports as part of an enterprise addendum.

Attached: Redwood_Mirana_IAM_Response_20270517.pdf (contains the completed Excel mapping and a brief implementation runbook).

Next steps we suggest:
1) Confirm prefix for scoped SCIM groups (you said "MIRANA_").
2) Confirm whether Mirana will provide a signed certificate and ACS endpoints for SAML, or whether you prefer we generate SP metadata for you to import.
3) If the 6-year archival option is required for PHI-related audit exports, we’ll loop Legal for a short addendum to the SOW.

We’ll stand by to update the PDF with any requested wording changes and can supply implementation playbooks once you confirm the SCIM scope and ACS details.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: Redwood_Mirana_IAM_Response_20270517.pdf (1.2MB)
